theme_central: Woe to the slanderer who amasses a fortune believing it will make him eternal — the Hutamah awaits him, a fire that rises to the hearts.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: The slanderer, the fortune hoarder
branches.resume: Woe to every slandering backbiter who amasses and counts his fortune, believing it eternal.

children.t: Slanderer hoarding fortune, illusion of eternity

branches.title: The Hutamah, closing
branches.resume: He will be cast into the Hutamah, Allah's kindled fire that rises to the hearts, closing in on them in columns.

children.t: The Hutamah, kindled fire closing in on the slanderer
